card.name: T in TAF and TDF abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letter T that starts the abbreviations TAF and TDF (tenofovir alafenamide / tenofovir disoproxil fumarate) in HIV drug labels. It also fires on the T in FTC/TDF.

modes.label: Abbreviation in parentheses
modes.description: T opens TAF or TDF in brackets right after the full tenofovir name.
modes.example: of rilpivirine (RPV), and 300 mg of tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (<<T>>DF).

modes.label: Abbreviation in dose or text
modes.description: T starts TAF after a dose in mg, or at the start of a sentence about TAF.
modes.example: One tablet containing 200 mg of FTC and 25 mg of<< T>>AF taken orally once daily

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed words; it may steer the model away from RNA-related continuations.
card.plain: It spots the first letter of the abbreviations TAF and TDF for tenofovir drugs in HIV labels.
